tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Armour plates: every module, the top bar and the timeline. White armour in light, hangar gunmetal in dark. All chrome text sits on paper.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Hover fill on controls, key caps, stat cells' rules.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: Behind the sky photograph, and the shadow behind map labels. The universe is the same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, names, numbers, timeline bars, on paper.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: alert subtitles, feed text.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Quietest legible text on paper: meta, labels, ages, paths (6.3:1 light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Panel lines: plate edges and the rules between rows. Never the only separation between two controls.

tokens.name: hair-2
tokens.usage: Edges of fields and line buttons (3:1 on paper), future bins on the timeline.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Ultramarine structure: primary button fill, the unit tag on every module, focus ring, selection. Deeper than Codex blue and never used for an agent.

tokens.name: blue-2
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: blue-line
tokens.usage: Line-button text and icons on paper (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a blue fill (8.6:1 light, 5.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Needs you: a question, the alert tick, red lock brackets, waiting timers. As text on paper 5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: red-fill
tokens.usage: The needs-you alarm fill in both themes (white text 5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and the square mark on red-fill.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Caution: a permission request. The hazard stripe, row stripe and lock brackets. A mark or a fill, never text on light paper.

tokens.name: yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Permission as text on paper (5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and hatching on a yellow fill.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done, ready for review: row stripe and lock brackets.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Done as text on paper (5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Live and now only: the live dot and the timeline's now marker. Never text.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around the live dot and the now marker.

tokens.name: cyan-ring
tokens.usage: Halo ring of the live dot.

tokens.name: claude
tokens.usage: Claude agents: provider dot, ship marks, legend. Equals AUR.PROVIDERS claude.

tokens.name: codex
tokens.usage: Codex agents: provider dot, ship marks, legend. Equals AUR.PROVIDERS codex.

tokens.name: chart-ink
tokens.usage: The view headline and system names over the universe.

tokens.name: chart-ink-2
tokens.usage: Map meta lines and the legend over the universe.

tokens.name: chart-ink-3
tokens.usage: Quiet systems and the drag hint over the universe.

tokens.name: chart-vignette
tokens.usage: Edge darkening of the sky, strongest under the top bar and the timeline.

tokens.name: chart-red
tokens.usage: A question over the universe: red lock brackets, the ping and the waiting line under a system (same in both themes).

tokens.name: chart-yellow
tokens.usage: A permission over the universe: yellow lock brackets and its line under a system.

tokens.name: chart-green
tokens.usage: Done over the universe: green lock brackets and its line under a system.

tokens.name: galaxy-warm
tokens.usage: One galaxy's ring and label (Personal in the sample).

tokens.name: galaxy-violet
tokens.usage: One galaxy's ring and label (Open source in the sample).

tokens.name: galaxy-blue
tokens.usage: One galaxy's ring and label (Work in the sample).

groups.name: Poster
groups.note: Heavy, slightly expanded Archivo in capitals, set straight onto the universe the way a poster sets its title over the sky. Nothing in the chrome goes under 12px.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The view's name over the universe, top left, in chart-ink. One per screen. 40px at phone width.

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: The boxed line under the headline, and the catalogue line above it.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product name in the top bar.

groups.name: Modules
groups.note: Module headers and rows: names and labels in capitals, running text in sentence case.

styles.name: mod-title
styles.usage: Module titles.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: The two-digit count at the right of a header.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Labels, header meta, legend, stat labels.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A number in the Summary grid.

styles.name: stat-word
styles.usage: A name in the Summary grid, where a number would go.

styles.name: alert-name
styles.usage: The agent and its ask in a needs-you alert.

styles.name: row-name
styles.usage: Agent name and status on a fleet row.

styles.name: feed-text
styles.usage: Event feed sentences, the agent bold.

styles.name: btn
styles.usage: Button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Go to a project, agent or file
styles.usage: Field text and the screen root. 16px in fields at phone width.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for what you compare digit by digit, and for the stencilled unit tags.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, hour labels, the drag hint.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Module unit tags, the build code, the now label.

styles.name: row-sub
styles.usage: Second line of fleet and feed rows.

styles.name: alert-wait
styles.usage: How long an agent has waited, in its attention colour.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The live clock in the top bar.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Key caps.

groups.name: Star chart
groups.note: Labels over the universe, each with a space-coloured shadow behind it.

styles.name: map-name
styles.usage: A system with something happening.

styles.name: map-dim
styles.usage: A quiet system.

styles.name: map-meta
styles.usage: Lines under a system name, in chart-ink-2 or an attention colour.

styles.name: map-galaxy
styles.usage: Galaxy labels in the galaxy's colour.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Plates sit 12px from each other and from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text in tight marks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between modules in a rail, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The gutter, and module side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups in the top bar and the timeline.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Headline block inset over the universe.

size.note: Fixed heights that keep every plate on one rhythm. The rails hug their content; the universe shows wherever there is no plate.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: The top bar.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Every module header, open or folded.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Fleet and feed rows, two lines.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons inside modules. 40px at phone width.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Top-bar controls and fields. 40px at phone width.

tokens.name: dock-h
tokens.usage: The timeline across the bottom.

tokens.name: rail-l
tokens.usage: The left rail at desktop width.

tokens.name: rail-r
tokens.usage: The right rail; the only rail below 1200px.

tokens.name: tag-w
tokens.usage: The unit tag at the start of a module header.

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: The 45° cut at the top-right corner of every plate.

radius.note: Armour is cut, not rounded: square corners plus one chamfer. Only dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Plates, buttons, fields, key caps.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Provider and live dots only.

shadow.note: Plates sit over space, where a shadow cannot show; edges do the work.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Unused on chamfered plates; kept for menus that open over them.

duration.note: Motion is rare: hovers, the needs-you ping, folding.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills.

tokens.name: dur-collapse
tokens.usage: A module folding to its header.

tokens.name: dur-ping
tokens.usage: One needs-you ping around a locked system.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition and the ping.
